description: Core's own kinds (ADR 0079 decision 3). A FOLDER organizes only: it lives at the root or in another folder, carries a cover, roots a READ or READ_WRITE link (never WRITE_ONLY: a drop box is a node of its own, ADR 0080 decision 11), and is the one guest container (ADR 0080 decision 6). A SHARE_BOOKMARK keeps a public link a member received, sealed in its meta (ADR 0120, share-bookmark-meta.v1.schema.json): at the root or in a folder, no child, no cover, the root of no link, created by no guest.
